sensitivity_view: Hold programs with any v0.5 prior-risk alert, exact healthy-participant condition or broad condition. This is an uncertainty stress test, not adjudicated exclusion.
unit_proxy_label: Any recorded registry start within unit; otherwise unresolved if any unresolved program; otherwise no recorded start. This descriptive unit endpoint is not validated clinical truth or a verified negative.
score_model: Independent units; correlated bivariate equal-variance Gaussian scores within each true class. Positive means sqrt(2)*Phi^-1(AUC). Scores are synthetic, not model predictions.
test: Two-sided paired AUROC difference with DeLong placement-difference variance and normal alpha=0.05 critical value. Half credit for ties. Fewer than two observations per class is not estimable.
uncertainty: Wilson 95% Monte Carlo binomial intervals exclude label-validity, model and data-distribution uncertainty.
null_calibration: Run delta=0 at observed base-unit counts for every correlation without label error. Retain rejection rates. Failure to cover alpha is an approximation warning, not a reason to tune to model results.
interpretation: Scenario power only. No observed clinical AUROC, AP, calibration, locked-test performance, validated prevalence or independent sample-size claim from program totals.
clinical_readiness_gate: Adjudicated events and negative or censoring definitions
Chronologically eligible origin features and models
Adequate power under plausible dependence and label error
